category_edits.rationale: Test whether reducing pointwise calibration weight from 0.2 to 0.15 improves ranking across all four datasets while retaining BPR and valid-position averaging. This changes only the training objective; model shapes and prediction remain compatible.

response.change_summary: Reduce only the shared pointwise-loss coefficient to 0.15. Preserve one GRU4Rec model per category and all other settings.
